subject_line: An Author Spotlight for The Scion Conspiracy
email_body:
Hi Mike,

I saw that The Scion Conspiracy, the first book in your Crucible of Legacy series, arrived in the fall of 2025, and it stood out to me that you wrote it as an Atlanta firefighter with a grimdark take on an Age of Exploration setting.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

The option I think could suit The Scion Conspiracy is a cinematic book trailer with a few short promotional reels. If a trailer or a set of reels for the book is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit The Scion Conspiracy best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
